class.name: robot_pvt_control/RobotPVTController
class.description: Whole-body PVT (CiA 402 mode 5) controller. Streams position / velocity / torque-FF / Kp / Kd to every drive at 1 kHz; the drives run τ = Kp·Δp + Kd·Δv + τ_ff in firmware. Streaming setpoint topic (~/setpoint) and FollowJointTrajectory action (~/follow_joint_trajectory) with cubic/quintic-Hermite interpolation, plus hold/free services. Links librobot_safety for clamps + thermal Kp derating + e-stop FREE/HOLD.
